security.label: Privacy and security
security.title: Privacy is our top priority.
security.intro: We work to make KOVA as secure as possible. Financial records stay on your phone. Optional Play purchases and this website have separate data flows, explained below.
cards: Financial data on your device
The main database uses SQLCipher with local profile isolation. Protect your phone and backup password. Encryption is not a guarantee against every device, access or data-loss risk.
Optional Premium through Google Play

The current candidate uses the Play billing interface, without a KOVA verification server. Play uses its own network for purchase, restore and access refresh. KOVA receives purchase status and signed purchase details, not card details. Your financial records are not sent through Play.
Local access and restore

Current Premium access may need another connected Play check after up to 48 hours or a phone restart. Restoring purchases is separate from restoring financial data. The Free base, saved records and backup/export remain available; full public-sales qualification is pending.
Your backup is your choice

Create a password-protected manual export and store it safely. It is a partial copy; keep external attachments separately. A cloud folder or share action uses your chosen provider, rather than automatic KOVA financial sync.
This website is separate

This site cannot read your phone database. Google Analytics measures website visits and interactions only with your consent. Rejecting keeps the full site available. Change your choice in Cookie settings; hosting and provider details still require confirmation before a new public deployment.
Report safely
Contact contact@kovacompass.app with the app and Android version and steps using example data. Do not send passwords, purchase tokens, full backups or real financial records.

delete-account.label: Your data
delete-account.title: Export and delete local data.
delete-account.intro: Your financial profile stays on your phone; it is separate from a Google Play account or subscription. You control local records, backups and exports.
cards: Save what you need first
In data settings, use manual encrypted export of supported records and select a destination. Keep the password. This is a partial export, not a copy of every setting, key, and installation file.
Delete local data

To remove data for the whole installation, open Android settings → Apps → KOVA → Storage → Clear data, or uninstall KOVA. Labels vary by system. Without a valid backup this is irreversible; it may affect every local profile in that installation.
Files outside the app

Delete exported copies, original photos, and files held by other providers separately. An image embedded in a note may be included in export; an external URI is only a reference. The publisher cannot remotely access your local database.
Messages to the publisher
For data shared by email, contact contact@kovacompass.app. Do not attach financial backups. This page neither deletes data nor sends an automatic request.
A subscription is separate

Deleting app data or uninstalling KOVA does not cancel a Premium subscription. Manage renewal in Google Play. Restoring purchases does not restore financial records, and importing a backup does not grant Premium.

cookies:
Cookies

Analytics is your choice.

Essential cookies remember language and settings. Analytics starts only after consent.

Updated: 22 October 2026No advertising

Essential

kova_site_language remembers language for up to 12 months; kova_cookie_consent_v2 remembers your choice for 180 days. Previous consent to local counters does not authorize Google Analytics.

Google Analytics 4

After consent on the public kovacompass.app domain (including www), we load Google tag G-2LE3GWYDZM. Google may store _ga and _ga_2LE3GWYDZM cookies for browser and session recognition. We configure 180-day expiry without automatic renewal on every visit; browsers may shorten this period.

What we measure

Page views, opening and playing the presentation, chapter selection, enlarged screenshots, opened FAQs and contact clicks. Our events contain only the event name, public page without URL parameters or fragments, and language. We do not send message contents, finances, account IDs or Workspace contents. Local previews do not run Google Analytics.

Recipient and basis

Publisher: Vadyslav Konohrai, Poland; contact: contact@kovacompass.app. Optional measurement relies on your consent. Google Analytics also processes technical browser, device, session and approximate location information. IP addresses are involved in communication; Google states GA4 does not store IP addresses. This does not make the data fully anonymous. Processing may take place outside the EEA. See Google’s privacy policy and GA4 data information.

Site language

The language choice also remains in localStorage until browser storage is cleared. KOVA account data is not stored here.

Change your choice

Open “Cookie settings” in the footer and reject analytics, or turn it off and save. Refusing does not limit the site. Withdrawal removes accessible GA cookies and reloads the page to stop the tag. It cannot recall data already sent. Contact us about data rights; you may also complain to the relevant data protection authority. Privacy documents remain readable without choosing consent.

Pre-publication status

Draft information updated 22 October 2026. Integration is website-only; the Offline V1 app remains analytics-free. Google Signals and advertising consent are disabled in code. Before publication the publisher must confirm processing terms, transfers, GA4 service retention (separate from cookie lifetime), disabled automatic enhanced measurement, and hosting configuration. Local tests do not verify these settings.
